entities.summary: Anthony B. Smith is an American former professional football player who was a safety for six seasons in the National Football League (NFL). After playing college football for the Syracuse Orange, he was selected by the Pittsburgh Steelers in the third round of the 2006 NFL draft. Smith was also a member of the Green Bay Packers, St. Louis Rams, Jacksonville Jaguars, and Tennessee Titans. He is a two-time Super Bowl Champion with the Steelers in 2008 and the Packers in 2010. Smith retired from professional football in 2012.
